what: Pressing the button on the round sidebar floating at the left widens the clip-path that cuts the sidebar by 450px to the right (.5s ease), revealing a side panel attached to the sidebar, while a blur scrim (dark ink 35% · blur 20px) covers the back in .4s. Panel content turns on in .8s power2.out after the other panel fades off in .2s. Closing with the same button, the close button, the scrim or Esc closes the clip first, then .5s later the content fades off in .2s — a portal drawer that swaps show search, help and menu in one sidebar

options.--fx-radius: Sidebar corner radius when closed (css variable), default --kf-radius-lg
options.--fx-dur: Length over which the clip widens (css variable), default .5s
options.--fx-veil-z: Blur layer (css variable) — lower than the sidebar, default 0
options.swap: Time for the other panel to fade out (s), default .2
options.hold: Time content is kept while closing (s), default .5
options.out: Seconds for content to fade out on close, default .2
options.x: Initial horizontal offset (px) when panel content enters, default 0
options.veil: If false, no blur veil is placed
